rationale: QUALITY. MOP for question SA: does the system carry the readings 400 m across the orchard with at least 96 % arriving? The band is the thesis's SR1 (Thesis sec. 3.6.2), whose 96 % the thesis says was recovered from the measured result, not set before the test. The value is the delivery rate the GUI project reports at 400 m (GUI sec. 4.1). Study category: REV-OBJ-1_Performance

name_th: SR-04_จ่ายพลังงานให้ตัวเองทั้งกลางวันและกลางคืน
rationale: TIME. MOP for question SA: how many hours of a day does a station fall short when it runs on its battery from full charge? The thesis's SR5 asks for recording around the clock, 24 hours a day (Thesis sec. 3.6.2; finding F-06), so any shortfall breaches it. The value uses the 16 hours the pole project reports for its battery (P2 sec. 4.2). Red as written: 16 hours from full charge is 8 hours short of a day (finding F-06). Study category: REV-OBJ-3_Reliability
